message: GPIO 4 is on ADC2, which is BLOCKED while WiFi is active. Analog reads will return errors or garbage.
hint: Use ADC1 pins instead (GPIO 32-39) which work with WiFi.

message: `wifi.connect` has no fallback if it fails.
hint: Without one the program carries on offline. Add `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.
